nodes.name: Receive Backup Request
nodes.notes: Entry point. Called by 01 only after Etsy accepted the listing.

nodes.name: Factory Config
nodes.notes: แก้ค่าตั้งค่าทั้งหมดที่ DEFAULTS ในโค้ดของ node นี้ (ดับเบิลคลิกเข้ามาแก้ได้เลย) รองรับ n8n Cloud - ไม่ต้องใช้ environment variable. Order: parent cfg > Variables > env > defaults.

nodes.name: Build Backup Plan
nodes.notes: Resolves and sanitises the four folder names of the backup path.

parameters.url: =https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q={{ encodeURIComponent("name='" + $('Build Backup Plan').first().json.folder_names.root + "' and mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and '" + $('Build Backup Plan').first().json.parent_root + "' in parents and trashed=false") }}&fields=files(id,name)&pageSize=1&supportsAllDrives=true&includeItemsFromAllDrives=true

nodes.name: Drive: Find Root Folder
nodes.notes: Look for 'root' under its parent. Makes the backup idempotent.

nodes.name: Check: Root Folder Exists
nodes.notes: Reuse the existing folder instead of creating a duplicate.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $('Build Backup Plan').first().json.folder_names.root, mimeType: 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder', parents: [$('Build Backup Plan').first().json.parent_root] }) }}

nodes.name: Drive: Create Root Folder
nodes.notes: Create the 'root' folder on first run. Google Drive OAuth2 credential.

nodes.name: Resolve Root Folder
nodes.notes: Normalises both branches into one folder id for the next level.
